blocks.x: Planning a trip around a big game, bucket-list concert performance, or Broadway show can make the experience even more memorable—but it also comes with stress as you work against the clock to compare ticket prices and secure the best deal. SeatGeek does some of the work for you, aggregating listings from multiple sellers in one place. Instead of visiting several ticket websites, users can compare prices, seat locations, and overall value in a single interface.

While we just made it through an absolutely electric string of 2026 FIFA World Cup games, celebrated all over the US, there is still much to look forward to this year when it comes to sports—and at that, traveling for sports. Lucky for you, SeatGeek breaks down the hottest upcoming events across North America, from MLB to NBA, NFL to NHL, MLS, and on. The site makes it easy and more affordable to celebrate the year of sports in style, while still being value-forward. Looking further out, Los Angeles will welcome the 2028 Summer Olympics, marking the third time the city has hosted the Games.

For sports fans looking forward to these events, or simply hoping to catch a concert, theater performance, or even a comedy show as part of their upcoming travels, ticket prices can add up quickly. Whether you are planning a weekend trip around a major sporting event or grabbing seats to a show while visiting a new city, promotions can help stretch your travel budget further while still securing great seats. Below, find the best SeatGeek promo codes and discounts available right now.
Claim $10 off your first purchase of $150 or more on the SeatGeek app with this coupon code
New customers can unlock a discount by booking through the mobile app. First-time app users can apply the SeatGeek promo code SEATGEEK10 during checkout to receive $10 off purchases of $150 or more.

The discount is particularly useful for travelers planning to attend premium events such as playoff games, arena concerts, or high-demand theater shows, since ticket prices for those experiences often exceed the $150 minimum required to activate the promotion. This offer is available to first-time app users and remains valid until December 31, 2026.
Secure a 5% military discount code on your next SeatGeek order

SeatGeek also offers a discount for active-duty military members and veterans attending live events. Eligible customers can receive a SeatGreek discount code, capped at $20, after verifying their military status on the SeatGeek website.

To apply, users must open the SeatGeek help chatbot located in the bottom right corner of the website and type “Military discount.” The chatbot will guide them through the verification process and provide instructions for applying the discount to eligible ticket purchases.
Make the most out of your next trip with SeatGeek app deals

Even without a SeatGeek coupon code, the mobile app can help you find ways to save. SeatGeek frequently highlights mobile-only deals for sporting events, concerts, and theater shows, particularly during busy travel and entertainment seasons. To help you plan for your next trip or big local outing, the site even has city guides with the hottest events in the area. SeatGeek's NYC roundup is best to check out before you make your city trip itinerary——and same goes for Los Angeles and New York. Currently on SeatGeek, Rangers tickets are selling from $58 and Harry Styles tickets are from $299.

The app also includes tools to make ticket shopping easier. Users can track ticket prices in real time to monitor how costs change leading up to an event, compare seat quality using SeatGeek’s Deal Score feature, and set alerts that notify them when prices drop for specific games or performances.
How to fix a SeatGeek promo code that’s not working

If your SeatGeek promo code isn't working, there's no need to worry. There are a few things you can do. For starters, make sure that you've entered the promo code correctly. Check for extra spaces, capitalization errors, and typos.

Then, double check that the promo code you're trying to use is still active and doesn't have a minimum spend requirement or any exclusions. If your SeatGeek promo code good from there, consider clearing your cookies and cache or switch browsers. If all else fails, reach out to the SeatGeek customer service for more support and advice.
